item.title: How I Built My Blog
item.description: Title: How I Built My Blog with Hugo and PaperMod Hello there! 👋 Welcome to my digital space where I share my thoughts, creations, and various musings. I thought I’d take a moment to walk you through how I built my blog using Hugo — a fast and flexible static site generator — and the PaperMod theme, which turned out to be a perfect fit for my needs. Why Hugo? I’ve always been fascinated by the simplicity and speed that static site generators provide.
